text:
erin_marketing: Quick sync — May 10 webinar launch. We need a compact paid plan (search + retargeting) that hits webinar signups while keeping CPA <= $55. Who's owning bids, creative swap cadence, and inbound lead routing?

james_paid: I can own bids. Proposal: $6k budget first 7 days, 60/30/10 split search/retarget/display. Day 1-2 burst on branded + high-intent non-brand (exact + phrase), then shift to broad match modifier with negatives. Use tCPA at $50 initially, tighten after 48h if conversion rate >= 3%. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sarah_growth: For creative: rotate 3 hero CTAs (Register, Seats Limited, Watch Live) every 3 days. Swap hero image + headline on day 4 to avoid ad fatigue. For retargeting, 7/14/30 day lists with different CTAs: 7d -> 'Last chance', 14d -> 'Watch replay', 30d -> 'New session'. Keep copy short; test 2 headline variants per ad set.

erin_marketing: Sounds good. Geo: US primary, CA/UK as secondary (cap at 12% of spend). Any objections?

james_paid: No objections. Suggest dayparting for peak hours 9am-6pm PT for search, 12pm-9pm PT for retargeting. Use accelerated delivery first 48h for burst.

leo_ops: Routing notes — webhook to SFDC webinar leads endpoint via our intake lambda. Please use UTM template below so we can auto-route by campaign_type and ad_variant. Also create a dedicated lead queue 'webinar_may10'.

leo_ops: ```utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=may10_webinar&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={ad_id}&campaign_type=search|retarget|display&ad_variant={variant}```

erin_marketing: @leo_ops can you confirm fields email/phone/utm in payload? We need to drop into Marketo too.

leo_ops: Confirmed. Payload: email, first_name, last_name, phone, utm_campaign, utm_content, campaign_type, source_platform. Marketo mapping will be handled by the same lambda.

james_paid: Quick tactical: block these negatives for non-brand buckets: "openai", "chatgpt", "free ai" — they'll eat clicks. Also set minimum bid floor on exact branded to avoid spend blowouts.

sarah_growth: Benchmarks: expect CPC $3.50-$6 on non-brand, CTR 3-5% for search, CVR to registration 2-4% (goal 3%). If below 2% after day 3, pause non-brand and reallocate to retarget.

erin_marketing: Decision: launch creative + search on May 3 for a soft ramp, full push May 6-10. James to set budgets/bids, Sarah to upload creatives by EOD May 1, Leo to validate routing/webhook by May 2.

james_paid: Got it. Will share shared sheet with ad group names + initial bid targets.

ads_bot: Campaign created — "may10_webinar_search" started as draft by james_paid. Link: https://ads.platform/campaigns/98765

sarah_growth: I uploaded 6 ad variations to the creative folder and added tracking names. Quick check: main CTA in creative should match UTM campaign_type for easiest QA.

erin_marketing: Perfect. We'll reconvene May 4 for first performance triage (15-min stand). Thanks all :thumbsup:

james_paid: I'll also add a simple script to cap spend if CPA > $80 over a 4h window. Pasting snippet in the sheet.

erin_marketing: Great — close the loop here once live and tag this thread.
